g.title: J_OBC_MAG
g.text: OBC J10: 3V3_SNS from U7, I2C4 SNS side via U14, DRDY via U33 to PD11

g.title: W6E
g.text: OBC to the +Z end frame through a wall gap; SDA and SCL each twisted with a ground; I2C at 100 kHz; under 2 mA

g.title: J_MAG
g.text: magnetometer board A2 J1 (RM3100 at 0x20), +Z end frame

g.title: J_EPS_ADCS
g.text: EPS J20: SW4 3V3_ADCS (ADCS_EN PB6), 0.265-0.339 A trip

g.title: W6B
g.text: 0.049 A worst normal (backup gyro on); 0.339 A at the SW4 trip: 68 % of the 26 AWG derated 0.5 A

g.title: J_OBC_ADCS
g.text: OBC J6: into U5 (gyro), U6 (BMI088), U7 (magnetometer, sun sensors)

g.title: J_OBC_MTQ
g.text: OBC J7: DRV8876 U22 (X), U23 (Y), U24 (Z) OUT1/OUT2

g.title: W6C
g.text: three twisted pairs; 0.087 A at 0.2 A.m2, 0.126 A at the bridges' hardware limit (25 % of 0.5 A). Route away from the RM3100 corner of the OBC (SQSO-OBC-BRD-001 14)

g.title: ROD_X
g.text: Molex Pico-Lock lead (rod side, per the CubeSpace ICD)

g.title: J_OBC_SS
g.text: OBC J8: cathodes to the TLV9002 transimpedance inputs, anodes to ground; pins 13, 14 shield drains

g.title: W6D
g.text: six twisted pairs in one shield, drains to OBC ground at J8 only; photocurrent at most 4 mA

g.title: PANELS
g.text: panel photodiodes (bought with the panels, BUILD_VS_BUY 2.3)
x6, short-circuit current at most 4.0 mA at AM0 normal incidence (requirement on the panel vendor)
